posts.post_caption:
📣JOIN us on Tuesday for the MAP Distro! ☀️
No qualifications, ALL are welcome!

🐝 10am - 12:30pm Resources & commUNITY 
🍎 10:30am-12:30pm Choice pantry open 

📍402 GRAND AVE., in DOWNTOWN GJ— ENTER from 4th Street. 

✊🏽Our commUNITY and advocacy partners THIS WEEK: 

🧐Jermaine from @[100071548461784:2048:Rocky Mountain Health Plans] will be available to assist with Medicaid/Medicare questions.

💦 Need WATER & street outreach? Phillip with @[100064544177647:2048:United Way of Mesa County] mobile outreach can help every Tuesday! 

🏡 Curious about the housing voucher waitlist? Sherry with the Neighbor2Neighbor program can assist!

✂Haircuts & Barber services by @[100063627756037:2048:Andy's Barber Shop] 10-11am💈

☕️ Breakfast & hydration station with Karalyn & Marian💛 10-12:30pm

GRATEFUL to @[100069792976649:2048:JustServe] LDS for the sack lunches last week! 🫶🏾

🌻 Last but not least, THANK YOU agency PARTNERS for your continued support: 

Western Slope -  Food Bank of the Rockies, La Plaza Palisade, Community Food Bank of Grand Junction, Mesa County Department of Human Services, Western Region One Source, Mesa County Public Health, Sunshine Community, Toilet Equity, Loving Beyond Understanding ☀️
